name: Plains Cabin (平原木屋)
use_for: small wooden houses, cabins, farmhouses, starter homes on flat grassland

materials.secondary_use: vertical corner posts + horizontal frame beams top/bottom of each storey (log frame = the cabin look)
materials.accent_use: spruce_planks interior floor, trapdoor window shutters, fence porch railing

windows.pattern: one 1x2 or 2x2 window centered on each long wall per storey; gable ends get one small 1x1

details.base: 1 block high cobblestone footing ring under all walls (moisture skirt), ground contact mandatory
details.chimney: optional cobblestone 1x1 chimney rising 2-3 above ridge, campfire on top
details.lighting: minecraft:lantern hanging from porch beam + one per interior corner
details.porch: optional 2-deep porch on the door side: spruce_slab deck, oak_fence posts, spruce_stairs entry
